messages.subject: Integration error in parboot
parts:
Hi,

I am trying to evaluate the goodness of fit for gdistsamp models but bootstrapping results in the error, " non-finite function value". I have read a few related threads in the group, and it seems as that the error may be related to NA's in the yearly-site-level covariates. Has anyone found a fix for the issue? 

Below is a summary of the unmarkedFrame, gdistsamp model, AIC and coefs, and the GOF test.

Thanks in advance!

Sean
